# Hickory Sands District

> The proposed Hickory Sands District American Viticultural Area in the Texas Hill Country. The land, boundary, vineyards and public record.

A site by the petitioners. Independent of the Alcohol and Tobacco Tax and Trade Bureau.

## Pages

- [A place defined by what lies beneath](https://hickorysandsdistrictava.org/): The proposed Hickory Sands District American Viticultural Area in the Texas Hill Country. The land, boundary, vineyards and public record.
- [About & contact](https://hickorysandsdistrictava.org/about.html): Who is behind the proposed Hickory Sands District AVA, and how to write to the district.
- [The boundary](https://hickorysandsdistrictava.org/boundary.html): A static map of the petitioners’ proposed boundary, with the live dashboard, documents and public-domain GIS downloads.
- [Sources & photography](https://hickorysandsdistrictava.org/colophon.html): The sources, maps, photographs, type and license behind the Hickory Sands District site.
- [Journal](https://hickorysandsdistrictava.org/journal.html): Notes from the proposed Hickory Sands District: the land, the line and the record.
- [The land](https://hickorysandsdistrictava.org/land.html): The Hickory Sandstone Member of the Riley Formation, sandy ground and the Hickory Aquifer within the proposed district.
- [The map](https://hickorysandsdistrictava.org/map.html): The proposed Hickory Sands District on the map: the line, every step and every point; and, when you turn them on, the Hickory Aquifer in 3D, wells, vineyards and geology.
- [Status](https://hickorysandsdistrictava.org/status.html): Where the proposed Hickory Sands District AVA stands: the petition, Notice No. 243, the comment period and the proposed revision.
- [The vineyards](https://hickorysandsdistrictava.org/vineyards.html): The register of growers in the proposed Hickory Sands District.
- [Walk the line](https://hickorysandsdistrictava.org/walk.html): The proposed Hickory Sands District boundary, step by step, from the beginning point and back, with a map that follows the text.

## The public record

- [Public docket](https://www.regulations.gov/docket/TTB-2026-0005): TTB-2026-0005
- [Notice No. 243](https://www.federalregister.gov/d/2026-16670): 91 FR 52576
